notes: Matched treatment for tap-sender-loss-scan-diagnostic.json. Apply sender-controller-diagnostic.patch, sender-loss-scan-diagnostic.patch, then sender-loss-summary-diagnostic.patch to 13cdebd. Startup clock fix is absent.
All bitmap reads, including summary reads, consume the original work budget. loss_scan_reads/empty include summary work; loss_scan_summary counts summary reads separately.
Fixed loss-scan counters add no allocations or syscalls; existing controller diagnostics add clock reads and immediate/1Hz monitor snapshots. No builds/tests overlap load.
Continuations count scan chunks that exhaust their allowance while incomplete. Starts/completed include zero-inflight fast paths.
Directions L->R/R->L; endpoint arrays L/R. Receiver sample goodput excludes drain; missing ratios include drain. 100% CPU is one CPU.
TAP SKBs, queue drops and expired frames use different units and cannot be added into an exact frame-loss total.
The summary greatly reduces empty scanning and continuations, but goodput remains far below either performance gate.
